commit.message:
fix: [security] stop resolving strings to markup; sanitize UI svg icons

tryResolveHTMLElement parsed any string as HTML and appended it live, which is
how untrusted properties became XSS. Strings now resolve to text, matching the
1.4.0 PropertyEntry rule; return an element to render HTML. Drops the dead
createHtmlDL that fed it, and runs createIcon's svgIcon through the sanitizer.

- As reported by Jeroen Pinoy
